introHtml: Custom 2 oz shot glasses offer a versatile size for branded events and promotions. Slightly larger than standard 1.5 oz shots, they accommodate cordials, shooters, or mini Moscow mules. Perfect for trade shows, product launches, or barware giveaways, these glasses can be screen printed or frosted with your logo. Durable glass or plastic options ensure your message stays intact.
